config.description:
A position offset is applied to the GNSS measurement while the receiver continues to report a small covariance. The offset ramps in over 12 s so it cannot be caught by a single-epoch chi-square gate alone -- the windowed NIS and CUSUM drift detectors have to find it.
This is NOT a claim about spoofing. It reproduces the measurement signature of an inconsistent position solution, which multipath and ephemeris error can also produce.
